questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Difficult and the uni wasn't of much help. I had to have patience.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Lower your expectations. My apartment had mold and mice even though I payed 50% more than I do in Denmark.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was easy. I just checked my email every day and followed the steps.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There was a student counselor person that I could contact. However, the school was under organizational restructure while I was there, so in the end I had know idea who to contact. I still don't to be honest

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Easy. I got all the courses I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Just check your email each day and follow the steps.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Extremely competent teachers who where ambitious on our behalf. Really enjoyed that.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Same level as in Denmark. Maybe a bit higher in regards to the teachers level of ambition for the students. In one course my teacher recommended us to write a formative essay and read a monograph as extra curricular activities. I really liked the level om ambition.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Better because at the University of Manchester the professor also facilitates the tutorial classes, which gives better continuity from the lecture. You learn more as a student.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: If you are in anthropology, I would recommend them all!
